name: Supadock
long_description:
Supadock runs the day-to-day operations of logistics facilities with AI workers. We're not a software tool. We own the work.

We start at the gate, where someone has to check in every truck driver, verify their paperwork and decide who gets in, around the clock. Most facilities pay a security agency to do it by hand: it's expensive, error-prone and a major opening for cargo theft. Our AI workers do it 24/7 using the cameras, intercoms and systems a facility already has, at a fraction of the cost, and we've handled 12,000 check-ins since June.

The gate is where we start. Facilities that run themselves is where we're going.
